shared_context: The company strategy workshop requires a venue format that accommodates 5 participants comfortably, provides necessary technical support, and fosters collaboration. The options vary in location type, setup style, and amenities to suit different preferences and needs.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a senior strategist who values deep focus and team bonding in natural settings.
personas.private_goal: To choose a venue that maximizes team creativity and cohesion away from office distractions.

A.reason_for: Provides a quiet, professional environment with on-site AV support.
A.reason_against: Limited natural light and less informal atmosphere may reduce creativity.

B.reason_for: Modern and flexible setting that could foster collaboration.
B.reason_against: Potential distractions from other co-working members.

C.reason_for: Encourages focus and team bonding in a quiet natural setting, aligning with personal goals.

D.reason_for: Convenient and fully equipped with technical resources.
D.reason_against: Lack of environment change may reduce creative energy.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a pragmatic project manager focused on efficient use of time and resources.
personas.private_goal: To select a venue that balances privacy and technical support without excessive cost or travel.

A.reason_for: Quiet and professional with on-site AV equipment and moderate cost.
A.reason_against: Less natural light and informal atmosphere.

B.reason_for: Flexible and modern with Wi-Fi and projector.

C.reason_for: High privacy and focus despite longer travel and limited tech.

D.reason_for: Convenient, low cost, and full technical support.
D.reason_against: Less change of environment might reduce engagement.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a detail-oriented analyst who prefers familiar and well-equipped environments.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the venue has full technical support and minimal disruptions for productivity.

A.reason_for: Quiet and professional with on-site AV equipment.
A.reason_against: Limited natural light and less informal atmosphere.

B.reason_for: Modern setting with Wi-Fi and projector.

C.reason_for: Very high privacy and natural setting.
C.reason_against: Limited technical resources and longer travel time conflict with productivity needs.

D.reason_for: Full AV setup, IT support, and convenient access with no rental fees.

personas.private_goal: To pick a venue that minimizes logistical hassle while ensuring technical readiness.

A.reason_for: Professional environment with on-site AV equipment.

B.reason_for: Flexible space with Wi-Fi and projector.

C.reason_for: Very high privacy and quiet setting.
